articles.summary: Athens, Greece, October 19, 2026 – Imperial Petroleum Inc. (Nasdaq: IMPP) (the “Company”), a ship-owning company providing petroleum products, crude oil, and drybulk seaborne transportation services, announced today that the Company’s management estimates Imperial Petroleum Inc’s Net Asset Value (“NAV”) to be $691.1 million. This translates to a NAV of $14.93 per common share currently outstanding and $11.72 per common share on a fully diluted basis (assuming exercise of outstanding warrants and options for cash),
articles.title: IMPERIAL PETROLEUM ANNOUNCES MANAGEMENT ESTIMATE OF NET ASSET VALUE PER SHARE AND FLEET UPDATE
